    Tasks, projects and workflows are waiting for you. Change them, create your own and see what working in SprintSpaces feels like.

    01 / EVERYDAY TEAMWORK

    From a new request
    to a completed task

    Plan work, assign ownership and track delivery. Everyone can see what needs doing, who is responsible and when it is due.

    Kanban boards and sprints

    Move tasks between statuses and filter by assignee, priority or deadline. Use Scrum to plan sprints, estimate story points and follow progress on a burndown chart.

    Kanban · Scrum · burndown and velocity

    Projects, stages and deadlines

    Break projects into stages and tasks, assign owners and set deadlines. View plans on a timeline or calendar and track multiple projects in one list.

    Stages · timeline · calendar

    Custom fields and forms

    Define statuses, transitions and the fields you need, including required fields. Build forms that collect the details needed for a request. Each team can have a separate space with its own settings.

    Spaces · forms · templates

    Requests from email, too

    Connect a Microsoft 365 mailbox: incoming messages create requests, and replies join the conversation. Send notifications and reports through your own SMTP server, such as Gmail. Comments, attachments and history stay with the issue.

    Microsoft 365 · SMTP · attachments

    Time tracking

    Start a timer on a task or add an entry manually. Review hours in a calendar, submit a weekly timesheet for approval and export data to CSV.

    Timers · timesheets · exports

    Team reports

    Check progress, overdue tasks, workloads and time spent. Choose what goes into each report and schedule email delivery. You can also include an AI summary.

    Progress · overdue work · email reports

    Search and filters

    Find issues by text, assignee, status or deadline. Save frequently used filters, pin them to the menu and share them across your organization.

    Search · saved views · team filters

    Documents and knowledge base

    Keep instructions, decisions and file links in your team’s space. Version history lets you revisit earlier content, and search helps you find the information you need.

    Team pages · version history · help

    Change notifications

    Watch issues and get notified when they change. Choose email and push notifications for specific events in your settings.

    In-app · email · push

    03 / START WITH WHAT YOU HAVE

    Bring your spreadsheet data
    Without retyping

    Keep the tasks and decisions you already have.

    As part of your deployment, we will prepare automated data migration from Excel or Google Sheets . We will review the workbook structure, map columns to app fields and import the agreed data.

    • We will agree how to transfer tasks, stages, people, statuses and deadlines.
    • Before importing, we will validate the data and agree how to identify duplicates.
    • For Excel on SharePoint or OneDrive, we can configure two-way synchronization of selected data.

    We import Google Sheets data from an exported file. Migration and synchronization scope depend on a review of your spreadsheet, including its layout and formulas.

    SIGN-IN, PEOPLE AND ACCESS

    Sign in with the accounts
    your team already uses

    You do not need Microsoft 365. SprintSpaces connects to your existing company accounts or securely stores passwords itself. You decide who gets access and which requests need approval.

    Microsoft EntraGoogle WorkspaceOktaOpenID ConnectKeycloak · AD · LDAP · SAMLPassword + 2FA
    Let’s agree access rules for your company ↗
    01

    Flexible sign-in options

    Microsoft Entra, Google Workspace, Okta or another OpenID Connect provider — including a broker such as Keycloak with AD, LDAP or SAML. Enable several methods at once, or use SprintSpaces password accounts with required or optional two-factor authentication (TOTP).

    02

    People from your company directory

    The user list can sync with Microsoft Graph, Google Directory or SCIM 2.0. New joiners receive access, and leavers lose it. A blocked account loses access everywhere: in the browser, through the API and via AI agents.

    03

    Approvals recorded with the issue

    Send a request to the designated approver and see their decision and reasoning. If the approved scope or cost changes, a new approval is required.

    04

    Separate rules for confidential issues

    Only the requester and designated approver can see confidential issues. Being an administrator does not grant access to their content, and integrations never send it out.

    04 / ASSISTANT AND YOUR OWN AI AGENT

    Ask Spinka
    or connect your own agent

    Ask which tasks are waiting for you, how a workflow works or how much time was spent on a job. The assistant can find answers in the app’s data and knowledge base.

    GETTING STARTED

    What do you need?

    Users work in a browser and sign in with an existing account or a SprintSpaces password. We will help set up the server and integrations during deployment.

    FOR USERS

    A browser and an account

    • An up-to-date desktop or mobile browser: Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
    • A Microsoft, Google Workspace, Okta or other OIDC account, or a password account created in SprintSpaces.
    • No app to install on every computer.
    FOR YOUR OWN DEPLOYMENT

    A server for your organization

    • A Linux server, Docker Engine, Docker Compose v2 and an HTTPS address.
    • Persistent local storage for SQLite and attachments, plus backups.
    • Your chosen sign-in method and user directory; Microsoft 365 for incoming mail and any SMTP server for outgoing mail.

    We will size CPU, RAM and file storage for your team during the pilot. AI features require separate provider configuration.

    GOOD TO KNOW

    Before we start

    Do we need to change every workflow at once?+

    We can start with one team or workflow. Spaces have their own statuses, fields and views, so deployment can fit the way each department works.

    Can you migrate data from Excel and Google Sheets?+

    Yes. After reviewing the files, we will map columns to app fields and prepare an automated import. Google Sheets data comes from an export. For Excel on SharePoint or OneDrive, two-way synchronization of selected data is also possible. We will agree separately how to handle formulas and unusual spreadsheet layouts.

    Do we have to use Microsoft 365?+

    No. Your team can sign in with Google Workspace, Okta, another OpenID Connect provider or password accounts with two-factor authentication managed by the app. User lists can come from Google Directory, Microsoft Graph or SCIM. Microsoft 365 is needed only to turn incoming emails into requests; notifications and reports can use any SMTP server.

    How is the demo different from a pilot?+

    Launch the demo yourself in moments, without signing up. It is a separate copy of the app with fictional data, deleted after 15 minutes of inactivity. A pilot is a free trial deployment for your team, prepared with us using your workflows, data and sign-in setup.

    Are Spinka and an AI agent required?+

    No. You can use the app without AI. An administrator enables Spinka, and you connect your own agent through MCP. You approve its access scope in SprintSpaces; permission to change data must be enabled separately.

    Can I connect SprintSpaces to other tools?+

    Yes. Microsoft 365 mail handles requests and replies, and outgoing mail also works through SMTP. The REST API, CSV import and export, and signed webhooks let you build integrations and automations, for example in n8n or Zapier. MCP connects your own AI agent, while SCIM and Google or Microsoft directories supply user lists. For Excel on SharePoint or OneDrive, we can configure synchronization of selected data.

    Is the app only for developers?+

    No. Use it to manage projects, IT requests, purchase requests and administrative tasks. Statuses, issue types and forms are tailored to how your team works.

    What does the free pilot include?+

    Preparing your space, configuring the chosen workflow, migrating agreed data and introducing the app to your team. Before starting, we will confirm the scope and duration, terms for continued use, and any hosting or external service costs.
